correctness.rationale: Verified the no-jump two-qubit exchange generator, battery transfer f(t), density matrix and qubit passive-work expression; for p=1, W=ω max(0,2u-1). Each damped lobe has one peak u_k=exp[-F_k(x)] and log-curvature -2J²; F_k strictly increases and the count follows from strict inequalities, including equality and γ=0 / γ>=4J boundaries. Taylor expansion at the threshold gives width 2 sqrt(F_k’(x_k)(x_k-x))/J, peak linear, not uniform in k. The weak-loss total duration is a controlled many-lobe Riemann sum 2∫_0^{log2} P(s)ds=4G_Cat/pi-log2. Positive energy-basis coherence for 0<p<1 forbids passivity wherever u>0. Independent numeric peak, curvature and Catalan-value checks corroborated equations; numerics are not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact global damping-index classification, complete positive-time budget, and precise square-root extinction boundaries answer naturally motivated operational questions about usable charging windows; they are not just pointwise ergotropy substitutions. The distinction between exact positivity and finite detection threshold is explicit.

final_claim: The charger-damping loss x=γ/(4J) induces a finite exact staircase of positive-ergotropy Rabi lobes for fully excited input, unique thresholds F_k(x_k)=log2, fixed-lobe square-root window extinction and gamma times total positive-work duration converging to 4 Catalan/pi-log 2; coherent nontrivial initial charger amplitudes yield positive ergotropy whenever transfer is nonzero.
limitations: Fixed two-qubit resonant Markovian zero-temperature model only, battery local ergotropy not full-cycle efficiency.
Square-root law is for each fixed lobe k; coherence positivity is formal and can be below detection threshold.
